name: Tran'rek
label: Quest
description: Tran'rek: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: My cousin Tran'rek is in a tight spot. He promised me a load of scarab shells weeks ago and he hasn't delivered. He's my cousin, so I'd hate to have to send someone to Gadgetzan to break something on him.
Can you speak to Tran'rek for me? Let him know he needs to get that delivery together before I do something rash?
Gadgetzan is in northern Tanaris, in Kalimdor.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Oh, you spoke to my cousin Krazek? How is he? I hope Booty Bay is treating him well...
Scarab shells, you say? Well... Let me tell you a story...
